title: Issue and reply lifecycle, authors, editors, markers

cases.given: recorded HTTP fixtures for POST /issues, GET /issues/{n}, GET /issues/{n}/comments (3 pages), GET /issues/{n}/events
cases.expect: typed DTOs; pull requests filtered from issue listings; pagination followed via Link headers to completion
reply origin='remote', authorKind='remote', remoteAttribution login=arjun-gh; no Prism user created

cases.given: bot-authored comment 2211003 mirrored from r_1 with expected_body_hash H1; fetched body hash H2 ≠ H1; hint actor=arjun-gh
cases.expect: r_1 gets revision 2, editorKind='remote_actor', editorDisplay='arjun-gh (GitHub)'; not dropped as echo

cases.given: same as above but discovered by list_updates (no actor)
cases.expect: revision 2 with editorKind='remote_unknown', display 'edited on GitHub'

cases.given: op add_comment confirmed with expected_body_hash H1; webhook for 2211003 with sender=bot; fetched hash H1
webhook sender=bot but fetched hash ≠ every op hash
cases.expect: treated as real edit with editorKind='remote_unknown' unless events name an actor

cases.given: issue body rewritten by a human without Prism block delimiters
cases.expect: link.body_authority='forge'; Prism stops writing title/body; state/labels/replies keep syncing; UI message shown; identity via stored external id
labels and context block updated; title untouched
403 not editable; no remote write ever attempted

cases.given: a human copies an issue body (with marker) into a new issue #500
cases.expect: not matched: issue.user.id ≠ bot id; ignored with audit

cases.given: bot-authored issue on connector cn_gh2 carrying a marker for connector cn_gh1
projects P1 and P2 both target acme/openswitch; P1 links #412
cases.expect: applied to P1's link only; no dedupe by object id blocks P2 from later linking #413; delivery dedupe keyed by delivery id

cases.given: root promoted, create op still pending; user replies
cases.expect: add_comment waits behind create_issue; sent only after confirmation
